newsitem.title: ECUADOR: Ecuador's July trade surplus widens to $108 mln.
newsitem.headline: Ecuador's July trade surplus widens to $108 mln.

text.p: Ecuador's July trade surplus widened to $108 million from $36 million during the same month last year, the central bank said Tuesday.
Exports rose to $376 million from $336 million registered in July 1995. Imports fell to $268 million from $300 million.
In the first seven months of 1996, trade balance showed a $691 million surplus versus $143 million surplus in the same period last year.
